name: Renko
source:
A bright and sweet girl who loves her father and is attending in a certain school. She takes pride in being a virgin. It seems she wants her first time with the person she likes.
Despite being slender, her breasts are pretty large. Her bust size reaches three digits.
One day while she was on her way home from playing in the city, she was kidnapped by a bunch of thugs who were planning on raping her, but then...

[spoiler]Big breasted virgin girl who's been Maya Union's former assassination target with a priority number of 98. She and her beloved father are part of the Maya Union now, with her father being part of the group which leads the Maya Union, the central assembly. 
She was caught by the Royal Slave Knights, but was released afterwards due to Ryuu's decision. Later on, for some not yet known reason she transferred to Ryuu's school, Minkei Academy.[/spoiler]
